outcome: thrombosis of the inferior vena cava
cohort: A 30-year-old woman diagnosed with Hereditary Angioedema (HAE) type 1 or 2.
finding: A 30-year-old woman with Hereditary Angioedema experienced a significant worsening in the number and severity of angioedema attacks during pregnancy, which was further complicated by thrombosis of the ovarian vein and inferior vena cava following a cesarean section.
mod_finding: A cesarean section was complicated by thrombosis of the ovarian vein and inferior vena cava.
